meta.title: 咖啡拉花入门要看融合
meta.title_en: Latte Art Starts with the Integration
meta.topic: 咖啡 · 拉花 · 融合

scenes.title_cn: 融合做不好，图案再好看也白搭
scenes.title_en: Bad Integration Ruins Even a Pretty Pattern
scenes.context: 很多新手把重点全放在拉图案上，但拉花入门的门槛其实是融合。如果融合阶段做不好，后面图案再好看，整杯的口感与视觉都会打折。
sentences: 拉花入门一定要看融合。
Latte art beginners must focus on the integration.
integration（融合）
融合做不好，图案再好看也白搭。
If the integration fails, no pattern will save the cup.
pattern（图案）
杯口是奶泡，杯底是咖啡液，口感完全不同。
The top of the cup is foam, the bottom is espresso — two completely different textures.
texture（口感/质地）
paraphrase: 「基础不牢地动山摇」换种说法
The whole drink stands or falls on the first pour.
Patterns are the cherry on top of a solid base.
scenes.speak: Latte art beginners must focus on the integration. If the integration fails, no pattern will save the cup. The top of the cup is foam, the bottom is espresso — two completely different textures.

scenes.title_cn: 融合的本质：让奶泡和咖啡成为一体
scenes.title_en: The Essence: Foam and Espresso Become One
scenes.context: 融合的目标是把打发好的奶泡与浓缩咖啡充分混合，让整杯喝起来是『一杯完整的拿铁』，而不是上层泡沫、下层苦水的分层。
sentences: 融合的目标是让奶泡和咖啡成为一体。
The goal of integration is to make the foam and coffee one.
become one（成为一体）
好融合是一杯完整的拿铁。
A good integration is one complete latte.
complete（完整的）
杯子里的分层感，说明融合失败了。
Layering in the cup means the integration failed.
layering（分层）
paraphrase: Foam and coffee should read as a single drink.
When you taste foam and then bitter espresso, the pour failed.
scenes.speak: The goal of integration is to make the foam and coffee one. A good integration is one complete latte. Layering in the cup means the integration failed.

scenes.title_cn: 不融合的后果：图案浮在分离的液面上
scenes.title_en: What Goes Wrong: Patterns Float on a Split Surface
scenes.context: 不融合直接拉花，奶泡和咖啡液没有结合，图案看似画出来，实则浮在分层表面，入口先泡沫后苦水，风味被拆成两段。
sentences: 图案看着画出来了，其实是浮在分层上面。
The pattern looks drawn, but it's really floating on a split surface.
float on（浮在…上）
先喝到泡沫，再喝到苦水。
You taste foam first, then bitter espresso.
bitter espresso（苦浓缩）
一杯好拿铁的风味是完整的，不是两段的。
A good latte has one continuous flavor, not two separate acts.
continuous（连续的）
paraphrase: The art sits on top like a sticker, not part of the drink.
The sip breaks into two disconnected stages.
scenes.speak: The pattern looks drawn, but it's really floating on a split surface. You taste foam first, then bitter espresso. A good latte has one continuous flavor, not two separate acts.

practice: 「这杯拉花融合得很好」怎么说？
This cup has a beautiful integration.
「奶泡和咖啡融为一体」怎么表达？
The foam and espresso become one.
「图案浮在表面」用英文怎么说？
The pattern is just floating on the surface.
You get foam first, then bitter espresso.
pitfalls: Jump straight to the pattern and skip integration.
Fix the integration before you worry about the art.
A great pattern on a split drink still tastes bad.
Judge the drink by the art on top.
Judge it by mouthfeel and flavor throughout.
The design is visual; the quality is tasted.
Pour fast to chase a clean pattern.
Pour slowly and let the foam blend first.
Speed breaks the bond between foam and espresso.
Blame the pattern when the cup separates.
Blame the integration step you rushed.
Separation is a pour problem, not a drawing problem.
shifts: 把融合当作第一道门槛
只看杯面图案判断好坏
以口感与风味完整度为准
